answer: Each agent identity is registered to a public key whose possession is proven inside an Intel SGX or AMD SEV enclave, with remote attestation verifying the enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE for SGX) and approved platform. The measurement identifies code, not a unique chip; resistance comes from hardware-backed keys and enrollment controls, so duplicating a VM or software image cannot mint valid identities. An onyx, oasis, or nebula host still needs qualifying physical silicon and attestation.
